name: Soham Zemse
description: Soham Zemse is a protocol engineer contributing to Ream, an Ethereum consensus client. He previously worked at Privacy & Scaling Explorations (PSE) and on the Ethereum Foundation's JavaScript team, and before that at several DeFi startups. A proud crypto-native based in Mumbai, India, Soham likes to share one fun fact: he secured a UK visitor visa, famously tough to get from India, by showing a crypto wallet screenshot as proof of funds.
